TOTAL_IN_BYTES.description: Total bytes received since the service started, at this sample.

TOTAL_OUT_BYTES.description: Total bytes sent since the service started, at this sample.

RATE_IN_BPS.description: Receive rate at this sample, bytes per second.

RATE_OUT_BPS.description: Send rate at this sample, bytes per second.

NHS.description: Node Health Status - one snapshot of a node's own health.

NODE_ID.description:
Identifier of the node reporting (a peer identifier, host name or asset
identifier).

GENERATED_AT_MS.description: Unix milliseconds when the snapshot was taken.

STARTED_AT_MS.description: Unix milliseconds when the service started; 0 = unknown.

UPTIME_S.description: Seconds the service has been running.

SERVICE_MODE.description:
Operating mode the service runs in, as the service names it, e.g.
"full", "edge", "relay", "maintenance".

SOFTWARE_VERSION.description: Software name and version of the service, e.g. "sdn-server 1.4.2".

STORAGE_PATH.description: Location of the node's data store (a path or URI).

STORE_TOTAL_RECORDS.description: Records the node's data store holds.

STORE_TOTAL_BYTES.description: Bytes the node's data store occupies.

HAS_DISK.description: True when the disk figures below were measured.

DISK_CAPACITY_BYTES.description: Capacity of the volume holding the store, bytes.

DISK_AVAILABLE_BYTES.description:
Bytes on that volume available to the service (free bytes less any
reserve the service may not use).

HAS_NETWORK.description: True when the network figures below were measured.

TOTAL_IN_BYTES.description: Total bytes received since the service started.

TOTAL_OUT_BYTES.description: Total bytes sent since the service started.

RATE_IN_BPS.description: Current receive rate, bytes per second.

RATE_OUT_BPS.description: Current send rate, bytes per second.

HAS_COMPUTE.description: True when the processor and memory figures below were measured.

CPU_CORES.description: Processor cores available to the service.

MEMORY_TOTAL_BYTES.description: Memory available to the service, bytes.

CONNECTION_COUNT.description: Peers or clients currently connected; 0 = none or not measured.

NOTES.description: Short human-readable notes on anything degraded, e.g. "disk 92% full".
